label: after
measurement_notes: Only three samples per size were collected on a local Windows development server. Host load was not strictly controlled; the separate baseline window included an approximately 30-second frontend unit-test run. Treat values as diagnostic observations, not statistically significant claims or production latency guarantees.

Compared with the baseline runner, source hashing includes the new windowing/cache helpers and this runner explicitly waits for reopen pagination readiness, then records reopened_loaded_records. Append, loaded DOM and loaded heap methods are unchanged. Small reopen timing differences include added readiness checks.

At 5,000 records, collapsing evicts the oversized inactive directory cache and reopening fetches its first 200 records. Do not compare that reopen latency against the baseline's fully retained 5,000-record reopen. The 2,000-record reopen retains the complete cached data without extra src page requests.
All rows loaded here are files in one wide directory. Directory-heavy, deeply expanded trees and natural automatic-GC behavior were not measured.

environment.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/152.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

method.isolation: Synthetic route-fulfilled metadata only; all /api calls intercepted; existing isolated Playwright services at 8011/5175 with per-run D: runtime, no user database, model calls, imports or network repository access.
method.timings: Warm Vite application shell, independent browser page per sample. Node monotonic elapsed time includes Playwright IPC, waits and two animation frames. Append uses native DOM click, other interactions use Playwright click. Three samples per size, raw values only, not evidence of statistical significance.
method.loaded_records: Validated from page offsets and visible pagination counts, never inferred from mounted DOM rows. Pages requested one at a time through the actual load-more handler.
method.memory: Chrome CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after explicit HeapProfiler.collectGarbage; diagnostic JS heap only, not process RSS and not a measurement of natural automatic GC. CDP DOM counters may include detached nodes. Heap collection excluded from interaction timing.
method.longtasks: Optional browser PerformanceObserver longtask entries (>50ms), recorded over the whole sample including setup and diagnostic GC; not attributed to individual interactions.
